messages:
Lina (CS Ops): Heads-up: our healthscore buckets are inconsistent across playbooks. Some use raw_nps, others use normalized_health. This causes renewal playbooks to trigger at different thresholds. Need one canonical source and a backfill to re-score recent accounts.

Vik: Agreed. Proposal: canonical field = account.health_normalized (0-1). Derive from raw_nps, usage, and onboarding flags with current weights. Backfill window = last 180 days.

Samir: Safe plan: 1) add health_normalized_tmp, 2) compute in batches, 3) compare delta distributions, 4) swap. Keep a dry-run to measure playbook match variance. SQL sketch: 
```
UPDATE accounts a
SET health_normalized_tmp = clamp((coalesce(a.nps,0)*0.4 + usage_score*0.4 + onboarding_score*0.2),0,1)
WHERE a.updated_at > now() - interval '180 days';
```

Lina (CS Ops): Playbook matcher change: require health_normalized when present, fallback to legacy when null. Also add a flag to each playbook: uses_canonical_health = true/false for rollout.

Vik: Webhook payload for downstream systems when health changes: { account_id, health_normalized_prev, health_normalized_new, delta, event_ts, source:"health-backfill" }. Debounce 10m to avoid noise.

Samir: We'll rate-limit backfill writes to 500/min, run staging dry-run tonight, post pre/post histograms and 20 sample account ids.

eng-bot: Deploy queued for 2026-11-02 03:00 UTC by Samir. :gear:

Lina (CS Ops): I'll own verification and dashboard card: "% accounts using health_normalized" and "median health delta after backfill". Please post results here after staging.

Vik: Also add an e2e test: a renewal playbook should trigger only when health_normalized < 0.35 and onboarding_flag=false. Adds clarity.

Samir: On it. Running staging dry-run now; will post diffs in thread.
